title: Per-observation waterfall pixel mapping
description: The frequency and time calibration of one waterfall image. PER OBSERVATION, never a project constant: measured Hz/px was 123.46 on one client layout and 80.00 on another. The waterfall does NOT span samp-rate-rx; it spans a decimated band roughly 32x narrower, and nothing in the API reports that factor. Derive Hz/px from the rendered axis ticks on every image. See docs/SATNOGS_API_RECON.md section 7. Ratified 2026-08-17 by Bob (task A0): added crop_box field (the spectrogram area after axis and colorbar removal, which is what the model sees); clarified degraded semantics; tightened derivation enum descriptions.

image_width.description: Full PNG width in pixels including all margins.

image_height.description: Full PNG height in pixels. Represents the time axis; scales with pass duration, do not hardcode.

plot_box.description: Bounding box of the spectrogram plot area as drawn by matplotlib, including tick lines but excluding axis labels. Measured by detecting the non-white transition. Two known layouts: x=66..686 (client v2.3-compat) and x=74..677 (client 2.1.2).

crop_box.description: The pixel region delivered to the model after removing axis labels, tick text, and the colorbar. Always strictly inside [0, image_width) x [0, image_height). Null only when derivation is 'failed'. One client renders a colorbar at x=724..755 that a naive non-white column crop swallows; crop_box excludes it.

hz_per_px.description: Frequency span per pixel column inside crop_box, derived from the rendered axis ticks. NEVER derived from samp-rate-rx. Null when derivation is 'failed'.

seconds_per_px.description: Time span per pixel row inside crop_box, derived from observation start/end and image height. Null when derivation is 'failed'.

centre_px.description: Pixel column (within crop_box, 0-based from its left edge) corresponding to the 0 Hz offset relative to the receiver centre frequency. Null when hz_per_px is null.

derivation.description: How hz_per_px was obtained. 'axis_ticks': read directly from detected matplotlib tick positions. 'axis_ticks_ocr': tick positions plus OCR of tick labels. 'client_family_fallback': used a lookup table keyed on client_family when axis detection failed but the client family is known. 'failed': could not establish Hz/px; hz_per_px and crop_box are null, degraded is a non-null reason code.

derivation_confidence.description: Confidence in the derived hz_per_px. 1.0 for clean axis_ticks detection. Lower for ocr or fallback. Null when derivation is 'failed'.

degraded.description: Named reason code when the mapping could not be established. Non-null exactly when derivation is 'failed'. Example codes: NO_AXIS_DETECTED, BLANK_IMAGE, ZERO_BYTE, MALFORMED_PNG, UNKNOWN_LAYOUT, ALPHA_ONLY.
